# Protocol datatype helpers

Unmodified files from the npm package `minecraft-protocol@1.68.0`:
`src/datatypes/compiler-minecraft.js`, `minecraft.js`, and `lpVec3.js`.
The upstream BSD-3-Clause license is included as `LICENSE`.

Only these binary helpers are used with ProtoDef and Prismarine NBT.
No upstream login, authentication, connection, or default-version code is loaded.
The packet schema is the project's fixed protocol 776 / Minecraft 26.2 schema.
Player info flags are corrected at compilation using the official 26.2 enum order.
